title.narrative: A Community of Dialogue in Ukraine

description.narrative: We are a volunteer group of Danish Ambassadors for Dialogue who as part of Silba want to explore the opportunities for working with dialogue in collaboration with Ukrainian youth. More than 10 years of experience and knowledge have been gained through DUF’s Ambassadors for Dialogue program in DUF and we would like to create a partnership and project building on all of this. The current DUF project Ambassadors for Dialogue is an international partnership between DUF and three other youth organizations in Egypt, Jordan and Tunisia. The project was started with the aim of creating change after the Arab Spring. The aims of the AFD program are to foster a dialogical culture among youth in Denmark and the Arab world to implement in their daily lives and in corporations between youth in order to enhance mutual understanding across ethnic, religious, ideological, regional and other divides. Whilst most of our work as facilitators of dialogue has been taking place in the Middle East, in 2021 we facilitated a dialogue workshop in Kiyv with UDYH - and we had planned to continue this work but had to pause this due to the full-scale invasion of Ukraine. We are still very interested in exploring the possibilities for expanding this previous mentioned program into the EaP region, and thus it would be interesting to explore the possibilities of working with a youth organization in Ukraine.
